name: Майстерня зв’язок (1)
description:
You already learned the pin party in the black level. The pin is an incredibly strong weapon because the pinned piece loses a lot of power. With the pin party, you take advantage of that. A pinned piece cannot perform its defensive tasks properly, allowing you to capture a piece that is seemingly protected. 

What do you have to do? 

Win material with the help of a pin. The pinned piece cannot perform the defensive task properly.

examples.text: The black rook and white king are on the same line. Black can take advantage of this with 1...Bxe5! Due to the pin, White cannot take back the bishop.
The bishop on d4 seems well protected, but appearances are deceptive. With 1.Rxd4! White wins material.
